title: Inisfada school for gifted children did remote viewing
place_text: Inisfada, Long Island, New York, USA

tellings.quote: And it was called Inis Fard when he was there. And it was like this weird school for gifted children. And they would do the remote viewing stuff.

plain: A strange school for gifted children at a place called Inisfada, on Long Island in New York, is said to have trained its pupils in remote viewing, the practice of trying to see distant places or hidden things with the mind alone. Jay Anderson tells this on Jesse Michels's show, passing on what a man named Eric Hecker, who was there, told him. If true, it would mean children were being taught psychic skills in an ordinary-seeming school.
